answers.how: Tracking a fixed box marking gives approximately 885 px/s², so the scale is 9.8/885 ≈ 0.0111 m/px. The box width is about 183 px.
The box's full vertical extent is approximately 106 px in a clear mid-fall frame. Multiplying by the acceleration-derived scale, 0.0111 m/px, gives its height.
The truck spans approximately 763 px horizontally. Using the acceleration-derived scale of 0.0111 m/px gives its length.
The truck spans approximately 319 px from the upper basket to the ground. Using 0.0111 m/px gives its height.
The tire's outside diameter is approximately 78 px. Multiplying by 9.8/885 m/px gives approximately 0.86 m.
The measured trajectory starts essentially from rest. With acceleration 9.8 m/s², the speed at 0.2 s is 9.8 × 0.2.
The measured trajectory starts essentially from rest. With acceleration 9.8 m/s², the speed at 0.4 s is 9.8 × 0.4.
